ResearchProjectDef.label: vacuumize process
ResearchProjectDef.description: Material production in vacuum effectively avoids interference from common gases such as nitrogen and oxygen during chemical reactions. Researching materials science outside the atmosphere is especially valuable for special materials like Tantasteel, which are prone to oxidation when processed in atmospheric conditions.\n\nThis research unlocks Tantasteel production in vacuum-compatible box furnaces and sintering furnaces.

ResearchProjectDef.label: early warning and manual fire control
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks the passive acoustic warning mirror, the manually operated one-channel fire-control radar, the early rotary rail, and legacy flak gun. These low-power systems provide short-range warning and limited interception before an active radar network is available.

ResearchProjectDef.label: basic missile engineering
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks first-generation loitering munitions, the V2 ballistic missile, launch rails and towers, missile storage racks, missile assembly, and the strike planning table. Advanced guidance and long-range variants require further research.

ResearchProjectDef.label: orbital dynamics
ResearchProjectDef.description: By studying fundamental orbital mechanics and space environmental characteristics, you can develop equipment and precision devices designed for vacuum microgravity conditions, as well as a family of specialized caseless firearms built from advanced materials.\n\nKey materials and components for this equipment rely on trade with the colonial fleet, but deeper research can eventually enable fully independent production.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Carbon synthesis
ResearchProjectDef.description: Industrial-scale organic reactions can convert carbon dioxide and water into organic biomass. This "turn air into food" technology reached commercial viability before World War III, with energy conversion efficiency roughly eight to thirty times that of traditional agriculture.\n\nThis research unlocks construction of a bioreactor that consumes electricity and graphene to synthesize carbohydrates composed of starches, sugars, and other organic compounds.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Microgravity Manufacturing
ResearchProjectDef.description: Additive manufacturing in microgravity can achieve complexity and precision far beyond what is possible under gravity. Once gravity is removed as a constant constraint, many fundamental assumptions in materials science and manufacturing are significantly altered.\n\nThis research unlocks construction of a large assembly machine for producing items in microgravity.

ResearchProjectDef.label: Aerospace Applications
ResearchProjectDef.description: By scaling up Tantasteel and graphene production and exploring the key applications of these specialty materials in aerospace and microelectronics, this research unlocks nuclear thermal propulsion engines and orbital electronic-warfare stealth equipment for gravships and orbital starships.

ResearchProjectDef.label: ballistic platform research
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks the Minuteman III-class advanced ballistic missile body and its dedicated parts: low-yield and stellar-guided packages, penetration aids, and MIRV buses. Assembled directly in strategic silos and launch towers.

ResearchProjectDef.label: radar detection network
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks the active search radar and its shared early-warning network. Completing this research enables NPC world-map detection, interception, alert escalation, and blockade circles; local map air defence remains available independently.

ResearchProjectDef.label: fire control and interceptor guidance
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks independent fire-control radar, multi-channel surface-to-air launchers, and modern interceptor missiles. Search and fire-control radars serve separate roles: a search radar finds and tracks; a fire-control radar locks targets and guides supported interceptors.

ResearchProjectDef.label: advanced missile engineering
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks precision guidance components, light and tactical missiles, compact launchers, the Scorer cruise-missile system, and the strike command center. Autonomous seekers do not need a fire-control channel; command-guided and semi-active missiles do.

ResearchProjectDef.label: cutting-edge missile engineering
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks strategic launch silos and vertical launch systems, advanced cruise missiles, hypersonic anti-ship weapons, advanced interceptors, and thermonuclear warheads.

ResearchProjectDef.label: phased-array and integrated air defence
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks the phased-array radar and the highest-capacity integrated air-defence systems. This military electronics branch requires a radar detection network and fire-control network; Aerospace is only needed by equipment that actually consumes its specialist materials.

ResearchProjectDef.label: anti-ship missiles
ResearchProjectDef.description: Unlocks the anti-ship loitering munition. Supersonic anti-ship missiles also require advanced missile engineering; hypersonic anti-ship missiles require cutting-edge missile engineering.
